mapper.select: SELECT user_id, nickname, championships, runner_ups, points FROM game_player_stat ORDER BY points DESC, championships DESC, runner_ups DESC, updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_player_game_stat (game_id, user_id, nickname, matches, wins, losses, points, championships, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{matches}, #{wins}, #{losses}, #{points}, #{championships}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT best_score FROM game_player_stat WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE game_player_stat SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
